deck: Two reports, two days, one mechanism.  Digiday published this morning on why the biggest creators are cutting their brand lists.  Adweek published yesterday on what the replacement looks like when it works.  Both describe the same trade: the fee is turning into a stake.
tldr: The biggest creators are cutting their brand lists and asking for equity, product input and job titles instead of fees, and Alix Earle told Digiday she wants five or six brands a year rather than a hundred.  Put a non-cash offer in front of your two most important creators this week.

Sydney Sweeney's Novig advert passed 65 million views on Instagram in September, and she is an equity partner who started the deal herself before the campaign existed.  Treat creative control and a stake as the going price for the people you most want, and find out today how long an equity grant takes to paper at your company.

Just over a million people watched Dedsafio 4 on Kick at one moment, and three channels out of 312 carried 50.14 percent of its 28.79 million hours.  Ask for the per-channel table before you discuss a package price, then buy the top three channels directly.

Valorant Champions peaked 7.8 percent higher than last year while its average audience fell about 11 percent, and almost 8 percent more channels carried it.  Make average concurrent viewers the pricing metric in every live sponsorship brief you write this quarter.

Canon's 100,000 dollar First Cut contest requires entrants to post their pitch publicly and tag the brand, so the entry condition does more work than the prize fund.  Add a public, tagged post to the eligibility rules of your next contest or giveaway.

TikTok used a survey of stated intent to claim it is advertisers' top platform for 2027 increases, then launched an ad network that places advertising across nearly 400,000 other apps.  Ask your representative in writing to split any 2027 proposal into on-platform and Ad Network lines with separate reporting.

Peak Torque cut his runtime from hour-long podcasts to eleven-minute engineering verdicts and did 158,556 views on one video with 70,600 subscribers.  Send technical reviewers your product with no script, and pick the hostile ones first.
